# Route an accepted job to an actionable notification

## Intended user and outcome
For operations teams using self-hosted n8n, this template checks a previously accepted MaxVideoAI job and routes its current outcome to completion, failure-or-refund, or user-action notification placeholders. It provides recovery from a known job ID without creating a new quote or charge.

## How it works
1. Accepted Job Input receives a POST body containing `acceptedJobId`.
2. Require Accepted Job passes that ID to a deterministic MCP Client call for `get_generation_status`.
3. Route Actionable Outcome reads the returned status and payment status, then sends the item to exactly the relevant notification placeholder. Replace the no-op destination nodes with your reviewed delivery integrations after validating their data-handling rules.

## Setup
Import this disabled workflow into a self-hosted n8n instance. After import, create a MaxVideoAI MCP OAuth credential for `https://api.maxvideoai.com/mcp`, complete OAuth in the owner-approved account, and attach it to the Get Generation Status MCP Client node. Protect the webhook, pass only an `acceptedJobId` obtained from an earlier accepted confirmation, and keep secrets and credential references out of exported JSON.

## Approval, recovery, and supported scope
This workflow does not prepare or confirm a generation. Human review of the exact quote and explicit upstream approval must already have occurred in the workflow that produced the accepted job. Recovery is read-only and uses only `acceptedJobId`; a creative retry needs a fresh quote and approval elsewhere. This candidate covers the validated deterministic MCP Client path on self-hosted n8n. n8n Cloud and AI Agent use through MCP Client Tool are explicitly unsupported here and remain outside the public compatibility claim. A live failed/refunded notification delivery is still unverified.
